# Loose surface matter observation

## Dry wipe observation
On a cooled item at the bench, make one gentle pass with the designated clean dry observation pad. If the visible matter transfers to the pad and leaves the underlying surface clear, record loose contamination. If the silver appearance remains fixed and no matter transfers, record adherent surface change for grading under the surface rubric. If transfer is partial or uncertain, record uncertain and refer to the bench assessor; do not force a bloom grade. Retain the observation pad in its labelled sleeve.

## Observation boundary
This is an observation instruction, not a cleaning or polishing allowance. Abrasive removal would destroy the distinction it is meant to record.
